description: Every URL the V1 site answers, and where it goes after the cutover. Sources are the crawled live route list, not a derived guess. A V1 path that exists identically in V2 is recorded as a replacement; everything else falls back to the V1 archive until someone confirms a real replacement. Nothing is retired without a stated reason, and no unmapped URL is swept to the homepage.

dispositions.reason: The V1 quickstart is the V2 editor quickstart. Confirmed, not inferred: it was hand-mapped in the V2 redirect config before this registry existed.
